title: Flavor Capability Matrix
notes: S1392. Generated from app_v2/build.gradle.kts productFlavors by scripts/docs/generate-flavor-matrix.ps1; conformance of other docs enforced by scripts/quality/assert-flavor-matrix-docs.ps1. Do not hand-edit.

title: OCR Overlay Accuracy Exchange
notes: Three-sided engineering exchange with doc-html-translate (P:/WINDOWS/EPUB_2_HTML) and FastMediaSorter Lite on OCR overlay geometry, colour and measurement. Written in English while the counterpart documents are Russian - deliberate, stated in its front matter. Each round is appended as a numbered section; never rewrite an earlier round in place without leaving a forward-pointing note. Read it before changing TranslationOverlayView, RecognitionBackend filters or TesseractManager iteration level.

title: Maestro UI Test Suite
notes: S1720: the runner's own documentation - installing Maestro on Windows, preparing an AVD, authoring and debugging flows, and the test-media workflow. Kept apart from `quality-assurance`, which holds protocols and scenarios rather than a tool: a query for the Maestro runner has to land here, and a change to these files has to fail the staleness gate rather than be skipped as unregistered. Read before touching maestro/*.yaml or the devtest runner scripts.

title: On-demand Delivery Inventory
notes: Pinned on-demand payload names, hashes and hosting contract. Update whenever a delivery descriptor or CI-fetched prebuilt asset changes.

title: Play Release Operator Runbooks
notes: The operator-side Play Console checklist, its historical quick reference, and the current Play listing publishing contract. The standard release gate remains docs/RELEASE_READINESS_STANDARD.md.

title: Stream Catalog Source Specification (handoff set)
notes: Format description of everything the offline publisher scripts/streams/collect-stream-candidates.ps1 produces - the catalog CSV, the favicon atlas, the ZIP layout, the preview and logo atlases - written as a snapshot for whoever reimplements the feature. Sections marked [CONTRACT] are consumed by external applications. Who those consumers are and what each has pinned lives in docs/STREAM_CATALOG_CONSUMERS.md instead, because that list changes when someone else changes their client, not when our code changes (S1828).

title: Stream Catalog External Consumers
notes: Registry of applications outside this repository that read our published stream-catalog assets, the asset names and numbers each has hard-coded, and a verdict per contract rule saying whether a check enforces it, the code merely happens to satisfy it, or nothing protects it. Read before renaming or re-revisioning any published asset. Enforced in part by scripts/quality/assert-stream-asset-revisions.ps1 (S1828). Unpublished: it names external parties and their internal constants.
